text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A drink. A makeup artist I know
recommended it to me. It's crazy bitter. Seriously gross.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I heard it works wonders on the skin right away.
So I thought I might give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I just have to put up with the taste.
It's way better than getting skin trouble and missing work.
It seems Gold City is troubled by skin breakouts...
